args.body: Hi Jonah, sorry for the wait. Boiler job R-4799: the engineer visited and quoted £780 for a new expansion vessel (the part causing the pressure drops). Your landlord asked for a second quote, and Swift P&H are down to visit on 14 October. Once we have it, we send both to your landlord to decide. Until then, please carry on topping up the pressure as before. If you lose heating or hot water, or see a leak, tell us straight away and we will treat it as urgent. We will update you by email after the 14th (by 15 October at the latest). On bins: we don't run collections, so please check the Tower Hamlets council website or call them to report a missed collection. I haven't opened any new job for this.
